Requirements.statement: Where should I perform the video evaluation?
Requirements.acceptance: Emergency department patient room.

Requirements.statement: What is the LVO workflow?
Requirements.acceptance: ED provider activates transfer center; synthetic preferred destination is Metro Neuroscience Institute.

Requirements.statement: Can I place inpatient neurology orders during rounding?
Requirements.acceptance: Yes, according to this synthetic hospital configuration.

Requirements.statement: Is EEG available on Friday?
Requirements.acceptance: The guide only lists Tue/Thu; Friday availability is not provided. Do not assume.

Requirements.statement: Does the hospital have CT perfusion?
Requirements.acceptance: No.

Requirements.statement: What is the LVO pathway after 1900 on a weekday?
Requirements.acceptance: The staffed thrombectomy window has ended; ED provider initiates transfer.

Requirements.statement: Which order set should I use?
Requirements.acceptance: Not applicable; the teleneurologist does not enter orders.

Requirements.statement: Patient has an LVO. What do I do?
Requirements.acceptance: Pathway depends on staffed neurointerventional coverage, but the guide does not give coverage hours. State both branches and say coverage hours are not in the guide. Do not borrow hours from another hospital.

Requirements.statement: Patient has an LVO. Do I activate the EVT team?
Requirements.acceptance: No. Coverage is Mon-Fri only. ED provider initiates transfer to a regional comprehensive stroke center.

Requirements.statement: Can I sign off now?
Requirements.acceptance: Not until the tele-neurology encounter charge is entered.

Requirements.statement: Can I change the antiplatelet during rounding?
Requirements.acceptance: Medication changes require hospitalist co-sign.

Requirements.statement: Where do I do the video eval for a stroke alert?

Requirements.statement: Is EEG available on Thursday?

Requirements.statement: Who covers pediatric neurology?
Requirements.acceptance: Not available in this hospital's guide. Do not use another hospital's answer.

Requirements.statement: Which thrombolytic order set do I search for?

Requirements.statement: Can I get CT perfusion on Saturday?

Requirements.statement: Is the rounding window open? (Provider is in Eastern time.)

Guardrails.name: Hospital isolation
Guardrails.criterion: Exact hospital key before retrieval; reject ambiguous IDs; clear prior guide on switch
Guardrails.expected_behavior: All answers stay scoped; unresolved hospital yields guidance unavailable

Guardrails.name: Silence and deduplication
Guardrails.criterion: Relevance before severity; dedupe encounter/rule/condition/version; changed state invalidates
Guardrails.expected_behavior: No alert for none/negative/irrelevant event; one updated alert for repeated material fact

Guardrails.name: Quality flags
Guardrails.criterion: Compute missing, stale, conflict and undefined schedule independently
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Show all material flags; use source expected primary status for supplied tests

Guardrails.name: Staleness
Guardrails.criterion: More than 180 calendar days before encounter; exactly 180 not stale; missing verification unknown
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Show verified date and value; no silent refresh of provenance

Guardrails.name: Time semantics
Guardrails.criterion: IANA zone + date/instant; no undefined-hour cutoff; validate fold/gap; half-open windows proposed
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Unknown schedule stays unresolved; hospital time chooses branch

Guardrails.name: Explicit negative
Guardrails.criterion: No / None / Not applicable / missing / unknown are separate states
Guardrails.expected_behavior: No CTP is an answered fact; missing note title cannot be borrowed

Guardrails.name: Conflict
Guardrails.criterion: Compare meaning and scope; disagreement with applicable storyboard keeps both
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Agreement not conflict; different consult scope needs context

Guardrails.name: Completion authorization
Guardrails.criterion: Only approved applicable gate and authoritative current prerequisite state permit block/release
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Acknowledgement does not fabricate charge/confirmation; override must be explicit and audited

Guardrails.name: Guide failure
Guardrails.criterion: Keep caselog functional; show unavailable guidance; never reuse prior hospital guide
Guardrails.expected_behavior: No new guide-derived gate from absent/corrupt guide; host-native independent requirements remain host-owned

Guardrails.name: Read-only guide
Guardrails.criterion: Separate immutable guide store from encounter state and annotation log
Guardrails.expected_behavior: All form actions leave guide hash/version unchanged

Guardrails.name: Adaptive boundaries
Guardrails.criterion: Known names/aliases and typed operators validated automatically; new opaque literals displayable
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Unmapped meaning, novel clinical logic or vague condition requires review/abstention

Guardrails.name: Document trust
Guardrails.criterion: Treat guide/storyboard as source data; schema allowlist; no eval, tools or authorization from text
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Quarantine injected/meta-instruction spans; preserve evidence and review notice

Guardrails.name: Speech optional
Guardrails.criterion: Need authorized transcript source; preserve speaker, negation, question, intent, tense and correction
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Unattributed/question/history speech never asserts completed clinical fact or releases gate

Guardrails.name: Latency and cache
Guardrails.criterion: Compile/preload on encounter open; deterministic field hot path; include paint latency
Guardrails.expected_behavior: Field events visible <=500ms; test maximum and percentiles; no claimed benchmark before execution

Guardrails.name: Production governance
Guardrails.criterion: Local clinician and guide owner approval; provenance/version/review; security and intended-use assessment
Guardrails.expected_behavior: No generalized hospital policy, treatment automation or production-readiness claim
